_source.note: Stabilization DVs are not repeated here — they live with the wound states in creation-rules.json, which is the one place that ladder is written down.

_rules.rest: A Character recovers Hit Points equal to their BODY for every full day of rest.
_rules.stabilization: A First Aid or Paramedic check against the wound state's stabilization DV stabilizes the patient. Stabilizing a Mortally Wounded Character restores them to 1 HP and leaves them Unconscious for 1 minute; at lighter wound states stabilization stops the deterioration but restores no Hit Points — those come back with rest.
_rules.cap: Healing never takes a Character above their maximum Hit Points.
